cover.desc: Full color, institutional palette. A long official noticeboard photographed straight-on, pale cream and grey, with one crisp white document pinned dead centre under glass: a form with a red stamp. Reflected faintly in the glass, small and slightly warped, three figures standing behind the viewer — a dark-haired boy, a pale-haired girl, and a hunched older boy with one eye covered. The document is sharp; the people are a reflection. Flat cel colour, hard-edged shadows, dusty blue and bone with one red accent on the stamp, huge negative space.

panels.bg: school noticeboard in a busy corridor, morning, students crowded round it, tone-washed
panels.action: Tuesday. There is a new document on the board and forty people looking at it.

dialogue.text: Tuesday.
It's got a stamp on it. Faculty stamp.
Layer thirty-three. They're reopening thirty-three.
Three names. One of them's a second year.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: half-lidded, reading over shoulders
chars.pose: standing at the back of the crowd

panels.action: He reads his own name on a wall for the first time in his life.

dialogue.text: SUPERVISED CLEARANCE ATTEMPT — LAYER 33
DIVERS: ARIAKE K. / HAZAMA K. / KIRISU W.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: nothing on his face, everything behind it

panels.action: His name is printed second and there is no blank-pin note beside it.

dialogue.text: Two years of that board having nothing to do with me.
And now it's got my name on it in the same font as everyone else's.

chars.name: student_a
chars.expression: turning round, spotting him, going bright

chars.name: student_b
chars.expression: elbowing another student

panels.action: Forty people turn round at once.

dialogue.text: That's him. Hazama. That's the ten.
Hazama-kun! Is it true you've cleared thirty-two?

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: the mild face going on like a coat

panels.action: He puts the face on and leaves.

dialogue.text: Two weeks ago they walked through me.
Same building. Same people. Different exhibit.
Hazama-kun! Wait — is it dangerous?
It's mostly walking.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: sitting at his desk, surrounded
chars.pose: hemmed in by five standing students

chars.name: tsubame
chars.expression: leaning on his desk, entirely friendly now

panels.action: The class has decided he is interesting.

dialogue.text: So what's it like? Thirty-two.
Does it hurt when you lose one?
Which one was the worst? Was it taste?

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: answering pleasantly, giving nothing

panels.action: He gives them the shape of an answer.

dialogue.text: It's dark. It's mostly walking.
That's not an answer.
It's mostly walking, though.

chars.name: gen
chars.expression: >_<, wading in, arms out, tiny

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: dot eyes, blank, tiny

panels.action: Gen executes rule one.

dialogue.text: RIGHT. EVERYONE OUT. HE'S DOING A FACE.
He's not doing a face, he's fine—
THAT IS THE FACE. I HAVE KNOWN IT SINCE FIRST YEAR.

chars.name: gen
chars.expression: sitting on the desk in front of him, arms folded, guarding

panels.action: He sits on the desk in front and stays there for the whole of first break.

dialogue.text: You don't have to answer any of that.
It's fine.
Rule three. You tell me. So — is it fine?

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: the tiniest honest answer he has ever given a room

panels.action: He answers honestly, which is new.

dialogue.text: Right. Okay. Then I'm sitting here.

chars.name: nabari
chars.expression: standing at the front of a small meeting room, folder open
chars.pose: hands on the back of a chair

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: seated, immaculate, gloves off

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: seated beside her, blank pin visible

chars.name: pike
chars.expression: seated, one boot on the chair rail, entirely relaxed

panels.bg: small faculty meeting room, long table, wall chart, tone-washed
panels.action: Wednesday, four o'clock. The first meeting of a thing that used to be a secret.

dialogue.text: This is now a supervised programme. That means paperwork.
Pre-dive calibration. Post-dive calibration. Written route plan.
Route plan signed by me before every entry. No exceptions.
Understood, sir.

chars.name: pike
chars.expression: raising one finger, delighted

panels.action: PIKE asks the question everyone else is too polite for.

dialogue.text: Sir. Two weeks ago this was an expulsion.
Two weeks ago it was unsupervised.
So the difference is the form.

chars.name: nabari
chars.expression: absolutely level, not defensive

panels.action: Nabari does not pretend otherwise.

dialogue.text: Yes. The difference is the form.
With it, if something happens to you, it happened to the school. Not to you alone.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: reading the route plan template, going still

panels.action: She finds the line that matters on page two.

dialogue.text: Sir. Section four. 'Positions assigned by supervisor.'
Correct.
So I don't choose front any more. You do.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: very slightly relieved and hating himself for it

panels.action: He is relieved, and he knows exactly what that makes him.

dialogue.text: Somebody else decides now.
That's the first time in two years I've been glad of a rule.
Positions on the sheet by Wednesday. Every week.

chars.name: nabari
chars.expression: putting a second sheet on the table

chars.name: pike
chars.expression: reading it upside down, face changing

panels.action: The second sheet is a medical eligibility schedule.

dialogue.text: Programme eligibility. Count of ten or below.
Ah.
Kirisu. You're on twelve.

chars.name: pike
chars.expression: grinning immediately, because that is what he does

panels.action: The bit arrives about a second too fast.

dialogue.text: Finally. Two years I've been trying to get out of Thursdays.
Kirisu.
No, this is great. I'll have a hobby. I'll get a plant.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: not letting it go past

panels.action: Kou does not let him do the bit.

dialogue.text: You held that arch for eleven seconds with two of us inside.
And now somebody with a stamp says I'm furniture. It's fine.

chars.name: nabari
chars.expression: quiet, offering something real

panels.action: Nabari offers the only thing he has.

dialogue.text: You can't dive. You can supervise from the arch.
Paid. On the staff sheet. It's a job, Kirisu.

chars.name: pike
chars.expression: the grin gone for exactly one panel

panels.action: One panel where the bit is not available.

dialogue.text: Nobody's ever offered me a job before.
...Fine. But I'm not wearing a lanyard.

chars.name: riko
chars.expression: standing in the doorway with a tablet and a printed rota

panels.action: Riko arrives ten minutes late on purpose, having already done the work.

dialogue.text: Mizusawa Riko. I'm doing the logistics.
I don't recall assigning—
I've done the route plan template. It was wrong in three places.

chars.name: nabari
chars.expression: taking the corrected template, reading it

panels.action: It is, in fact, wrong in three places.

dialogue.text: ...The gate timings are wrong.
By four minutes. Every Thursday since March.
Sit down, Mizusawa.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: looking at Riko with something complicated

panels.action: Kanade watches her friend take a seat at the table.

dialogue.text: She spent six days working out what I was hiding.
And she's spent the last two making it safer.

chars.name: riko
chars.expression: not looking up from the tablet

panels.action: Riko says one thing without looking up.

dialogue.text: Ariake. You get one lie a term and you've used it.
Understood.
Say it properly.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: saying it properly, in front of people

panels.action: She says it properly.

dialogue.text: I'm sorry I lied to you.
Yes. You are. Now sit down, we're doing route plans.

chars.name: shizu
chars.expression: standing in the calibration corridor with a form, flat

chars.name: nabari
chars.expression: in front of her, folder under his arm

panels.bg: corridor of numbered booths, evening, tone-washed
panels.action: Nabari asks Shizu to run the programme's calibrations.

dialogue.text: Twice a week. You're the most experienced technician in the building.
You want me to measure my brother twice a week.
...Yes.
Twice a week is more than the schedule requires.
I know.

chars.name: shizu
chars.expression: nothing, absolutely nothing

panels.action: She thinks about it for four seconds, which is a long time for her.

dialogue.text: I'd have found this difficult once.
I can tell it's the kind of thing I'd have found difficult.

chars.name: shizu
chars.expression: taking the form, signing it

panels.action: She signs it.

dialogue.text: I'll do it. I'm the only one who won't cry at the numbers.
Hazama-san.
It's an advantage. Use it.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: standing at the end of the corridor, having heard all of it

panels.action: Kou is at the end of the corridor and she knows he is.

dialogue.text: Go home, Kou.
You've been standing there since 'twice a week'.
Yeah.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: asking his sister a real question

panels.action: He asks her the thing he has never asked.

dialogue.text: Do you mind? Measuring me.
No.
That's not the comfort you want it to be. But no.
Right.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: walking a corridor that parts for her, face perfect

panels.bg: school corridor, students watching openly, tone-washed
panels.action: The building has decided what she is now, too.

dialogue.text: She threw away the recommendation for him.
The stream's already been reassigned. My sister's in the office.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: opening an envelope at her locker, reading two lines
chars.pose: one hand on the locker door

panels.action: The letter is polite and takes eleven seconds to read.

dialogue.text: RE: ADVANCED STREAM — DEFERRED PENDING PROGRAMME PARTICIPATION
Deferred. That's a kind word for it.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: reading it twice, entirely calm

panels.action: She reads it twice and finds she does not feel much.

dialogue.text: Six years of being first, and it's a paragraph.
I keep waiting to mind and I keep not minding.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: folding it, putting it in her bag

panels.action: She files it, the way she files everything.

dialogue.text: Nobody has ever asked me whether I wanted the stream.
Including me.

chars.name: riko
chars.expression: appearing at her shoulder with two drinks

panels.action: Riko does not ask about the letter.

dialogue.text: Route plan's due Friday. I've done most of it.
Riko.
Drink that and don't be noble in a corridor.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: at the stove, Saturday, sleeves up

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: in her place on the counter

chars.name: gen
chars.expression: on the floor with a bowl, thrilled

chars.name: riko
chars.expression: at the low table with her tablet, working

panels.bg: apartment kitchen, Saturday, four people, warm light, tone-washed
panels.action: Saturday. There are four people in a two-room flat.

dialogue.text: Gate opens at nineteen-forty. Not nineteen-thirty-six.
Why does she know that.
Because somebody has to.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: tasting, delivering the verdict

panels.action: The rota runs regardless of programmes.

dialogue.text: Under-salted. And the sharp thing arrives too early now.
That's the vinegar. Your number.
Then my number needs revising. Write it down.

chars.name: gen
chars.expression: >_<, scandalised, tiny

chars.name: riko
chars.expression: dot eyes, unimpressed, tiny

panels.action: Gen discovers the notebook.

dialogue.text: THERE'S A BOOK. THEY HAVE A BOOK OF EACH OTHER'S NUMBERS.
It's a recipe book, Ōkubo.
IT HAS INITIALS IN IT.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: writing in the book, not rising to it

panels.action: He writes it down.

dialogue.text: Vinegar: back to half. (K. — revised.)
Note that the first number was also mine.
It's noted. It's the same initial.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: quiet for a second in a loud room

panels.action: She looks round a kitchen with four people in it.

dialogue.text: Six months ago I had four hundred acquaintances.
This is more people than I have ever had in a room on purpose.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: on the balcony with two mugs

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: at the rail

panels.bg: balcony at night, city lights, tone-washed
panels.action: Gen and Riko have gone. It is half eleven.

dialogue.text: Very hot. Almost too hot.
You always say that.
It's always true.
Gen ate four bowls.
Gen ate five. I counted.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: asking the thing he has been carrying all week

panels.action: He asks about the letter, which she has not mentioned.

dialogue.text: Mizusawa told me about the stream.
It's deferred, not cancelled.
Ariake.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: honest, and finding it easy

panels.action: She tells him the truth she has only just found.

dialogue.text: I was first in the year because somebody decided I would be.
I've never once chosen a thing until this year.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: not comforting, offering the practical thing instead

panels.action: He offers her the only kind of comfort this series allows.

dialogue.text: Then choose the position too. Tell Nabari you want front.
You'd fight me on that in a corridor.
Loudly. But you should still ask.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: something going across her face and being put away
chars.pose: turning the mug in her hands

panels.action: She puts it away for now.

dialogue.text: He'd rather lose the argument than have it decided for me.
Nobody in six years. And then him, on a balcony, about a rota.
Thursday.
Thursday.

chars.name: pike
chars.expression: sitting on the arch steps in a staff jacket, deeply uncomfortable

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: beside him, kitted for a dive

panels.bg: landing of layer thirty-two, the white arch ahead, equipment crates, tone-washed
panels.action: Thursday. PIKE is on the staff sheet and wearing the jacket.

dialogue.text: It's got my name embroidered on it. Embroidered.
It suits you.
It absolutely does not and that's why I like it.

chars.name: pike
chars.expression: going serious, holding out a hand for Kou's strap
chars.pose: checking his kit like staff do

panels.action: He checks Kou's kit properly, because that is now his job.

dialogue.text: Left forearm's loose. Who tied this?
I did.
Mm. Get her to do it.

chars.name: pike
chars.expression: quiet, one eye on the arch

panels.action: He looks at the arch he is not going through.

dialogue.text: Two years I've wanted somebody to make me stop.
And?
And it turns out I wanted to be the one who said it.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: arriving, hair down, kitted

panels.action: Kanade arrives with a form in her hand instead of a plan.

dialogue.text: Position assignment. Signed this afternoon.
And?
Nabari's put you on front.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: absolutely still

panels.action: The supervisor has assigned the position, and it is his.

dialogue.text: He gave it to me.
I wanted it and I didn't have to fight her for it and it feels foul.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: arms folded, furious in the specific quiet way
chars.pose: standing squarely in front of him

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: not defending it

panels.action: She is not angry with him. She is angry with the paper.

dialogue.text: I asked for front. In writing. On Tuesday.
I know.
And a man with a folder decided instead.
I'm going to stand over here and be staff about this.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: saying the difficult true thing

panels.action: He says the thing he has been sitting on since the meeting room.

dialogue.text: When I read it I was relieved.
...Yes. I know. I could see it.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: the anger going out, something worse arriving

panels.action: This is the actual loss of the chapter and neither of them names it.

dialogue.text: It used to be ours. We argued about it in a kitchen.
Now it's section four, and we're both relieved, and that's worse.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: putting the form away, decision made

panels.action: She folds the form and puts it in her coat.

dialogue.text: Fine. You're on front. Today.
Ariake—
I said today.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: holding out her wrist without a word

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: taking it, starting to tie

panels.action: She holds out her forearm. He ties it. Two loops, flat on the outside of the wrist.

dialogue.text: Two loops.
It won't come off in water.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: at the front, sword low

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: at his right shoulder

panels.bg: the white void of layer thirty-three, flat and featureless, thin lines, tone-washed
panels.action: The first sanctioned entry. Everything is exactly the same and completely different.

dialogue.text: Comms check. Gate's held. Clock from now.
One. Two. Three.
It's warmer than last time.

chars.name: riko
chars.expression: at a desk at the arch with a stopwatch and three forms

panels.bg: the landing at the arch, folding desk, lamp, tone-washed
panels.action: Riko runs the clock from a folding desk. There is a folding desk in a dungeon.

dialogue.text: Ten metres at forty seconds. Twelve at fifty.
Kirisu, if they pass twelve you call it.
There is a DESK. In a DUNGEON.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: counting and describing, professional

panels.action: They get to twelve metres, which is further than anyone has been.

dialogue.text: Eleven. Twelve. Twelve metres.
Floor's changing. There's a seam.
There's a seam. Riko, there's a seam at twelve.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: crouched, hand flat on the floor

panels.bg: white floor, a fine dark line, tone-washed
panels.action: A single dark line in a floor that has never had one.

dialogue.text: Thirty-two layers and not one seam anywhere in here.
And there's a join. Somebody joined something.

chars.name: pike
chars.expression: at the arch, hand up, calling it

panels.action: PIKE calls it at fifty seconds, exactly as instructed.

dialogue.text: Fifty. That's the call. OUT.
Out.
Out.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: coming out first, which he has never done
chars.pose: stepping through the arch ahead of her

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: a step behind him

panels.bg: the arch, dark landing, desk lamp, tone-washed
panels.action: Both of them are out in under a minute. Nobody is dragged anywhere.

dialogue.text: Fifty-four seconds. Twelve metres. Logged.
That's a record. That's an actual record.
It's a seam. It's a record about a seam.
Both out. Both intact. Say it for the log.
Both intact.

chars.name: riko
chars.expression: writing fast, tablet and paper at once

panels.bg: folding desk at the arch, tone-washed
panels.action: Riko is already three steps ahead.

dialogue.text: A seam means a join. A join means a next room.
Nobody's ever reported a next room.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: flexing his hands, checking himself

panels.action: He runs his own inventory before anybody asks him to.

dialogue.text: Grip. Hands. Balance. All where I left them.
Fifty-four seconds and it didn't charge either of us.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: working it out out loud
chars.pose: hands on her knees, catching breath

panels.action: She says the thing that changes the series.

dialogue.text: It didn't take anything.
Under a minute. It's never taken under a minute.
So it isn't the room. It's the time in the room.

chars.name: riko
chars.expression: pen stopping

panels.action: Riko does the arithmetic instantly and does not like the answer.

dialogue.text: Then clearing it means staying in.
Long enough to cross a room nobody's found the end of.

chars.name: nabari
chars.expression: reading the log at his desk, everyone else standing

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: standing, still kitted

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: standing beside her

chars.name: riko
chars.expression: presenting the numbers

panels.action: Half nine. The debrief.

dialogue.text: Fifty-four seconds. Twelve metres. Zero threads.
Zero.
Zero, sir. It's the duration, not the entry.

chars.name: nabari
chars.expression: looking at the wall chart, thinking too far ahead

panels.action: Nabari sees the same thing Riko saw and likes it even less.

dialogue.text: Then a clearance attempt means a long stay.
Yes, sir.
How long is a room nobody has crossed?

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: answering plainly

panels.action: Kou answers the question honestly, which nobody wanted.

dialogue.text: Four minutes at walking pace, if the seam is the halfway point.
And at fifty seconds it takes nothing.
So four minutes takes several.

chars.name: nabari
chars.expression: closing the folder, deciding

panels.action: He makes the decision he has been avoiding for two weeks.

dialogue.text: Then the attempt is one diver. Not three.
Sir—
One person pays instead of three. That's the whole calculation.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: and Kou, in the same panel, both realising at the same instant
chars.pose: half turning to look at him

panels.action: Two people work out the same thing at the same time and neither says it.

dialogue.text: He'll volunteer. He'll do it before I finish breathing.
She'll volunteer. She's already worked out how to word it.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: speaking first, flat and fast

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: speaking at exactly the same time

panels.action: They say it simultaneously and Nabari has to put a hand up.

dialogue.text: Me.
Me.
...Sit down. Both of you. Now.

chars.name: nabari
chars.expression: tired beyond words, taking his glasses off

panels.action: He does not choose tonight.

dialogue.text: The attempt is in three weeks. I'll name the diver in two.
And I will name whichever of you has the lower count.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: understanding exactly what she has just been handed

panels.action: Her count is one. His is ten. There is no arithmetic to do.

dialogue.text: One against ten.
He's just told me it's mine, and he thinks he's being careful.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: the same arithmetic, arriving somewhere much worse

panels.action: He arrives at the same place from the other direction.

dialogue.text: Unless mine goes down, which it can't.
Or hers goes up.

chars.name: nabari
chars.expression: watching both their faces and seeing all of it

panels.action: Nabari sees exactly what he has just built and says so.

dialogue.text: And before either of you does anything clever—
counts are measured by a technician. Not by you.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: walking home beside him, hands in pockets, quiet

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: walking, saying nothing

panels.bg: night street, low walls, lamplight, tone-washed
panels.action: They walk the same road they always walk and neither of them does the inventory.

dialogue.text: You're not describing anything.
Neither are you.
No. I noticed that too.
We always do the inventory on this road.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: stopping under a streetlight

panels.action: She stops him under the light on purpose.

dialogue.text: Say it now, so it's said.
Say what.
That you're going to try and take it off me.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: not lying to her, because he can't

panels.action: He does not lie to her. He has never once managed it.

dialogue.text: Yes.
Thank you.
You're going to do the same thing.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: level, honest, unashamed

panels.action: They agree on the terms of a fight they are both going to have.

dialogue.text: Obviously.
Two weeks. Then one of us wins and the other one has to live with it.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: starting to walk again

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: falling into step on his left

panels.action: They walk on, and after about ten metres she starts the inventory anyway.

dialogue.text: Bicycle. Forty metres back. Slow.
Cat?
Cat's on the wall. Status unchanged.
She started it again anyway. Ten metres late.

chars.name: shizu
chars.expression: at the kitchen table at midnight with a stack of forms

panels.bg: apartment kitchen at night, one lamp, forms spread out, tone-washed
panels.action: Shizu is reading the programme's medical schedule at midnight.

dialogue.text: Counts measured by a technician.
I am the technician. Somebody has drafted this badly.
Somebody drafted this on a Tuesday.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: coming in, stopping when he sees the paperwork

panels.action: He comes in and she does not look up.

dialogue.text: You're going to ask me to write your count wrong.
No.
You were going to.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: caught exactly

panels.action: He was going to.

dialogue.text: I got as far as the stairs working out how to ask.

chars.name: shizu
chars.expression: setting the pen down, entirely flat

panels.action: She refuses in the most Shizu way available.

dialogue.text: I write down what the machine says. That's the whole job.
It's the only thing I've got left that I'm sure about.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: accepting it, and something else underneath

panels.action: He sits down opposite his sister for the first time in the series.

dialogue.text: Okay.
Kou.
If it's her, she'll be fine. If it's you, she won't.
I know.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: in the dorm at night, notebook open, pen still

panels.action: Half twelve. She is not writing descriptions tonight.

dialogue.text: Two weeks. Lower count goes in.
Mine: one. His: ten.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: writing one line and looking at it

panels.action: The line she writes and does not cross out.

dialogue.text: He cannot go lower.
So it has to stay mine.
So it stays mine. That's not a plan, that's arithmetic.

chars.name: riko
chars.expression: in the doorway in pyjamas, arms folded

panels.action: Riko in the doorway, on schedule.

dialogue.text: You're doing arithmetic.
I'm doing route plans.
Kanade. I do the route plans.

chars.name: riko
chars.expression: quiet, worried, not managing her
chars.pose: sitting on the end of the bed

panels.action: Riko sits on the end of the bed instead of arguing.

dialogue.text: Two weeks is a long time to be first in the year at something.
It's the only race I've ever wanted to win.

panels.bg: flat tone field, a wall calendar, a date circled in pen, the word ATTEMPT written under it in a neat precise hand, tone-washed
panels.action: The date on the wall, circled.

dialogue.text: Three weeks. Diver named in two.
